{{Quote|I am Lord Vacuus. The conqueror of Begeren. The killer of Garatak the Singed. Return what you have stolen or burn!|A worker possessed by Vacuus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Garatak''', also known as '''Garatak the Singed''', was an individual who lived during the era of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas's]] first coloniziation, and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vacuus]].
